name: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

known.via: English Wikipedia "Green Valley of Russian River Valley AVA"

ava.ucd: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Its cool climate is especially suited to Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
Merlot has a distinctive tea-like note, and Zinfandel shows tarter red fruit than in warmer Dry Creek Valley.
Its crisp grapes are prized for sparkling wine.

blurb.text: A Sonoma County AVA within Russian River Valley, formerly called Sonoma County Green Valley.
